verdict.rationale: Natural-language operation is a fair question for a payments platform, since it could ship an assistant or conversational interface, so the axis applies. The evidence pack shows no such capability. The llms.txt index and markdown docs (kushki-probe-1, -2, -4) only make the documentation readable by LLMs, which is a developer building block rather than a way to operate Kushki through natural-language commands. Every other item covers conventional API, SDK and checkout integrations.
